text:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported a service account got org-admin after SSO login. Looks like a role-mapping edge case during JIT.

akshay: Can you paste the SAML assertion we saw in the logs? need the claims shape.

maria: pasted below (sanitized):
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name=\"urn:okta:claims:tenant\">acme-corp</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"urn:okta:claims:eppn\">svc-build@acme-corp</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"roles\">service_account</Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

maria: The mapping config we use for JIT has a dual-lookup: prefer tenant claim, fall back to domain-from-eppn. If tenant is missing we do fallback.

tess: That fallback logic exists in mapper v2.1. It was intended to handle older IdPs. Problem: for service accounts we treat domain-from-eppn as tenant which can map to admin roles in some orgs.

akshay: Reproducer: if assertion has no tenant attr but eppn = svc@acme-corp, mapper resolves tenant=acme-corp -> looks up role bindings -> matches org-admin binding -> assigns admin.

maria: So a missing tenant claim + fallback -> unintended elevation. We saw 3 service accounts in logs in last 24h.

ranjit: Immediate mitigation: disable fallback for JIT mappings for any assertion where roles contains "service_account" OR require explicit tenant claim for non-human principals.

maria: Agreed. I've created a short ACL rule to block new JIT role grants for principals that have attribute service_account until we patch.

security-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-4527. Audit-log snapshot attached.

devops-bot: Quick query to find affected principals:
```
SELECT principal_id, assertion_id, mapped_role FROM sso_audit
WHERE mapped_role IN ('org-admin','org-owner')
AND assertion_claims LIKE '%service_account%'
AND ts > now() - interval '7 days';
```

akshay: Patch plan: 1) change mapper to require tenant claim for service_account principals 2) add an explicit admin denylist for JIT (no auto-admin) 3) emit an audit event when fallback is used. I'll open a PR.

maria: Also need a short-term rollback: disable mapper fallback flag globally and revert after patch. Can ops flip the flag?

ranjit: I can toggle the feature flag now. Will notify when done.

ranjit: toggled fallback=false for JIT mapping (prod). Confirmed no new JIT grants for service accounts in the last 15m. :white_check_mark:

maria: Good. Next: rotate keys/creds for the 3 impacted service accounts and revoke currently issued tokens. Add KMS audit: check HSM/KMS access patterns for these service accounts.

tess: Will schedule rotation and push a restricted key until we confirm. Also adding a telemetry rule to flag any JIT mapping that used fallback path.

security-bot: Adding remediation checklist to INC-2026-4527: revoke tokens, rotate keys, patch mapper, add audit events, postmortem.

akshay: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/mapper/pulls/812 — changes mapping check and adds unit tests + integration test for service_account.

maria: Can infra run the devops query to enumerate any historical admins created via this path so we can do a manual review? prioritize customers with external compliance needs.

devops-bot: Query queued, will group by tenant and send CSV to ops.

ranjit: One more note: we should also add a KMS ACL check so service accounts cannot request high-priv KMS keys without explicit approval. Ticketing that now.

maria: Thanks everyone. After PR merges, let's monitor audit logs for 48h and then schedule a blameless postmortem. I'll draft the postmortem and include the customer communication.

akshay: I'll add a regression test to CI to ensure fallback isn't applied to principals with attribute service_account.

maria: Closing the thread for now, update INC-2026-4527 with any new findings. :memo:
